findings.detail: The local 5D analyzer can emit ADVANCED_TO_ORIGIN_PRIME before DemiHead arbitration. This conflates a cognitive state-delta candidate with final promotion.
findings.next_gate: Rename the local result to ORIGIN_PRIME_CANDIDATE / CANDIDATE_STATE_ADVANCE and reserve ORIGIN_PRIME for verified return.
findings.title: Aura names a pre-arbitration state as ORIGIN_PRIME

findings.detail: PASS plus verified intent is sufficient for verified_return_eligible; the bridge does not require a candidate state hash, parent binding and non-zero delta.
findings.next_gate: Require advanced=true, candidate_state_hash != origin_state_hash, parent hash equality and a bound state_delta hash before verified return.
findings.title: DemiHead verified return is not bound to non-zero state advance

findings.detail: The live engine labels a local parameter as DemiHead arbitration. HOLD is safe, but the positive path is not end-to-end evidence that the DemiHead bridge actually ran.
findings.next_gate: Make final promotion consume and verify a DemiHead arbitration receipt hash rather than a bare PASS parameter.
findings.title: Home runtime accepts a decision parameter instead of requiring a real DemiHead receipt
